mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, sc.name AS sub_category_name, c.name AS category_name, s.keywords FROM spots s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) sp ON true JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
